KS-989 gate residue: the formatting gate fails OPEN on missing deps and reads the WORKING TREE, not the push — four items on one path

A push whose pre-push gate runs past ~6 min dies with rc 141 after the gate PASSED — GitHub closes the idle SSH session git opened before the hook; the launcher's core.sshCommand has no keepalive

workflow-approve persists the instance approved before the forward, so a refused forward strands it: re-approve and reject answer 400, no re-forward path, the kept document unusable until TTL (KS-1087 gate F2)

POST /api/certifications/:id/verify forwards a revoked session's Bearer to originate: the gateway's session check never runs on this route
api-gateway failed-login lockout is inert: createBruteForceProtection installs recordFailure, but no production code ever calls it — it can never block
Security: certifications ends RLS FORCE with no tenant_isolation policy on every fresh database, permanently
PR #1339's standalone locks were re-resolved from bare manifests: ~1,000 non-target moves, incl. runtime bullmq/msgpackr 2 and @azure/identity/msal-node 6
Verify is not bound to the credential's proof: a revoked credential resubmitted with another LIVE id still verifies true

Timestamping: the opentimestamps and blockchain types still report verified true, and /verify accepts a forged proof with no stored row (KS-753 gate m2)

GET /api/keys has no organisation arm: an ORG_ADMIN or ISSUER_ADMIN lists another organisation's keys in the same tenant
Chain-first verify blobs hard-code `anchored: true` and drop anchoring's status/acknowledged, so a 'submitting' or failed anchor reads isAnchored: true (v1 + v2)
A fresh clone has no pre-push gate: core.hooksPath is unset, so the 16-leg preflight silently does not run

Security: POST /api/documents/:id/version has NO per-document access check on its source - any write-role caller in the tenant can derive a new version from another organisation's document (the sibling of the certify path KS-1557/#1619 closed)
auth: the OAuth refresh_token grant never checks the ORIGIN SESSION, so a revoked session's refresh token still redeems and mints a brand-new session (oauth.ts:988-1089)
Security: GET /api/gdpr/deletion-log with no userId reads every tenant's deletion log — unfiltered SELECT on a table with no tenant_id, admitted to ORG_ADMIN
Security: three certification write routes have NO per-record access check - POST /:id/verify, /:id/share and /:id/recertify, while /:id/revoke checks the issuer and /issue gates on a write role
Node 26's semver-major Readable.read() change truncates every synchronous cbor.encode() to its first byte on host test runs - images pin node:24 and are unaffected
No supported way to put a user in a second tenant on a local stack — needed for cross-tenant systemTest peers (split from KS-1674)
systemTest (Schemathesis): run the object_level_authorization leg with peers in two different tenants (split from KS-1674)
anchoring POST /api/anchors/thread-mint spends the platform wallet outside withWalletLock for any authenticated caller (fee drain)
nft-certificate is handed the same platform wallet mnemonic as anchoring, and POST /api/nft/mint has no role check
anchoring: the in-lock confirmed write omits the transaction hash, so a same-payload upsert can leave a confirmed row with a NULL hash
POST /api/documents/:id/sign: any tenant user can sign any document, can turn a revoked document into signed, and no signature is verified
POST /api/documents/:id/lifecycle-events: any tenant user can record a lifecycle event on any document and trigger its anchor emission

tenant-provisioning checks no role on its own routes: any signed-in caller who reaches the service can suspend, archive, edit or delete any tenant
kyc: dbGetVerificationsByUser returns [] on any read error, so the GDPR erasure cascade (dbDeleteUserData) continues with an incomplete list, against its own comment
Billing: one Stripe purchase can be credited more than once (two events, post-grant retry, finalise/release catches)

api-gateway: ORG_ADMIN and ISSUER_ADMIN can set any user's verification level (tenant bound unmeasured)
